source.name: Charlton Athletic FC, TodayTix announcement
source.note: Two-year deal from June 2026 puts the TodayTix logo on the back of the men's and women's first-team shirts; confirmed on the 2026/27 Reebok home kit (2 Jul 2026) and away kit (19 Aug 2026), which women's first-teamers modelled.

summary: RSK Group, a UK engineering and environmental services group, fronts the Charlton Women shirt, with TodayTix on the back.

change.text: New to the WSL: promoted from WSL2 as play-off winners
